title: UKPNP High Level Delegation Briefs British MPs on Kashmir Crisis and Current Situation in London House of Parliament
excerpt: A high-level UKPNP delegation led by Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri briefed British MPs in the House of Parliament on the Kashmir crisis, human rights concerns, and the current political situation.
author: London Correspondent

heroImage.caption: UKPNP delegation meeting British MPs inside the UK Parliament.

body.text: A high-level delegation of the United Kashmir People's National Party (UKPNP) met British Members of Parliament in the House of Commons to brief them on the ongoing Kashmir crisis and the deteriorating human rights situation.

The delegation, led by UKPNP Chairman Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri, highlighted concerns regarding political repression, enforced disappearances, restrictions on civil liberties, and the humanitarian impact of communication blackouts.

body.caption: Delegation members presenting documents to MPs.

body.text: British MPs expressed serious concern over the reports and called for renewed international attention to the region. They emphasized the importance of peaceful dialogue, democratic rights, and the protection of civilians.

The UKPNP delegation urged the British government to raise the issue at the United Nations and other international forums, stressing that the people of Jammu & Kashmir deserve justice, dignity, and fundamental freedoms.
The meeting concluded with a commitment to continue engagement and ensure that the voices of the people of Jammu & Kashmir are heard at the highest levels of global diplomacy.
